rules.sdk: iOS 27 SDK (checked with Xcode 27.1, 27A9275, on the iOS 27.0 and iOS 26.4 simulators)

verdict.text: The Liquid Glass opt-out is ignored when built with the iOS 27 SDK; 4 custom styles to review first

findings.title: Liquid Glass opt-out that the iOS 27 SDK ignores
findings.message: Trailhead: the build setting INFOPLIST_KEY_UIDesignRequiresCompatibility is YES.

fix.title: Remove the build setting and review the screens with Liquid Glass
steps: Delete INFOPLIST_KEY_UIDesignRequiresCompatibility from the target's build settings. Xcode 27.1 does not copy it into the Info.plist it generates, so it has no effect there in any case.
Build with Xcode 27 and run the app on an iOS 27 simulator; the other findings in this report are the places to look at first.

findings.title: SwiftUI bar background set by the app
findings.message: toolbarBackground(Color.green) sets the navigation bar background.

fix.title: Remove the bar background modifiers
steps: Remove toolbarBackground(_:for:) and toolbarBackgroundVisibility(_:for:), or apply them only before iOS 26.
Keep the brand colour on tint(_:) and on the content, not on the bar.

findings.title: SwiftUI bar background set by the app
findings.message: toolbarBackgroundVisibility(.visible) keeps the navigation bar background visible.

fix.title: Remove the bar background modifiers
steps: Remove toolbarBackground(_:for:) and toolbarBackgroundVisibility(_:for:), or apply them only before iOS 26.
Keep the brand colour on tint(_:) and on the content, not on the bar.

findings.title: Custom tab bar or bottom bar
findings.message: The system tab bar is hidden with toolbar(.hidden, for: .tabBar).

fix.title: Use the system tab bar, or attach the custom bar with safeAreaBar
steps: Where the custom bar only restyles tabs, use TabView with Tab and tabBarMinimizeBehavior(_:) instead.
If the bar stays custom, attach it with safeAreaBar(edge:alignment:spacing:content:) so content under it gets the scroll edge effect, and consider glassEffect(_:in:) for its background.

fix.title: Remove presentationBackground for iOS 26 and later
steps: Remove presentationBackground(_:), or apply it only before iOS 26.
Look at the half-height detent: the sheet is inset and the content behind it shows around the edges.

sources.title: Apple: Adopting Liquid Glass (Windows and modals)

findings.title: Fixed bar height or safe-area arithmetic
findings.message: A tab bar height written as a number.

fix.title: Let the safe area carry the bar's height
steps: Remove the fixed height; place bottom content with safeAreaInset(edge:) or safeAreaBar(edge:alignment:spacing:content:).

sources.title: Apple: Adopting Liquid Glass (Controls, Windows and modals)

findings.title: Section header written in capitals
findings.message: Section header "NEARBY" is written in capitals.

fix.title: Write the header in title case
steps: Write the header as "Account" instead of "ACCOUNT"; the system styles it.
